posts.body:
Origami UI by Vishi221​
Immersive Window Transitions
Features:
-
Open Animation: Windows unfold vertically from the center instead of fading in.
-
Close Animation: Windows fold back into a flat line when closing.
-
Settings: Adjust the bounce strength and speed directly in the Plugin Manager.
Download and Terms of Use:
https://vishi221.itch.io/rpg-maker-mvmz-origami-ui
